run_mustc_data_prep: run the MuST-C data preparation script to extract fbank features and generate manifests for speech-to-text
run_mustc_joint_vocab: run the joint processing mode to generate a shared vocabulary across all 8 MuST-C languages
create_mustc_dataset: create a MuST-C dataset object to load audio segments with source and target utterances for a language split
extract_fbank_features_mustc: extract log mel filter bank features from MuST-C audio waveforms and save as numpy arrays
generate_mustc_manifests: generate TSV manifest files and config YAML for MuST-C data with vocabulary and cepstral normalization
